text:
maya: Heads up -- found another async error surface issue in python sdk (v0.9.2-alpha). Sync client returns requests.HTTPError with .response but async maps to RedwoodError early and strips the httpx.Response payload. Users can't introspect server validation errors.

maya: tiny repro (async):
```py
async with RedwoodClient(token=tok) as c:
    try:
        await c.messages.send(text=very_long_text)
    except ValidationError as e:
        # e.message is "validation failed" but no details about which field
        # expected: e.details == {"field":"text", "reason":"too_long"}
        print(e)
```

li: thanks. Are you seeing this also affect retry behavior? For us a 503 ended up as ServiceUnavailableError before retry, so requests didn't get retried.

maya: yes both: (1) loss of raw payload; (2) mapping before retry. The quick fix I used locally was to patch transport/error.py to set `wrapped.__cause__ = original` and `wrapped.http_response = getattr(original, "response", None)`. Also added `ValidationError.details` property that parses `.http_response.json()` when available.

sam: we should do two things in upstream: keep exception chaining (so `e.__cause__` is available) and expose a first-class `raw_response` attribute on our SDK errors. Also move the response-to-domain mapping to after retry success, so retry policies can act on transport codes.

sam: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/812 (labels: bug, async, retry, errors). I'll draft a PR.

li: for DX it's helpful to also include a typed dataclass on ValidationError like `ValidationError(details: Optional[Dict[str,str]] = None, raw_response: Optional[dict]=None)` so type checkers can help callers. Current error classes are untyped out of convenience which hurts users.

maya: yes a typed dataclass + convenience `.as_dict()` that tries raw_response.json() then falls back to parsed fields would be great.

sam: PR 813 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/813. Changes: attach __cause__, set `error.raw_response`, add ValidationError.details and .as_dict(), and reorder retry mapping. Added tests verifying: (a) `e.raw_response` present for async client, (b) 429/5xx triggers retry before mapping, (c) ValidationError.details returns parsed payload.

ci-bot: CI for PR #813: linux/py38, linux/py311 passed :white_check_mark:. https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/813/summary

maya: tested alpha wheel from artifacts, works for our app. Thanks! Leaving a small follow-up: docs example to show how to read structured validation errors without digging into __cause__.

sam: added a short docs blurb to the PR and a test snippet. We'll backport to 0.9.x as opt-in flag and make default in 0.10.

li: resolving on our end. Good catch, @maya :)
